 "data": "classDiagram
 class ProductController {
 +create(ProductRequest, MultipartFile) ProductResponse
 +delete(String productId)
 +fetchAll(page, size, sortBy, orderedBy) Page~ProductResponse~
 }
 class ProductService {
 <<interface>>
 +create(ProductRequest, MultipartFile) ProductResponse
 +delete(String productId)
 +fetchAll(page, size, sortBy, orderedBy) Page~ProductResponse~
 }
 class ProductServiceImpl {
 -ProductRepository productRepository
 -CategoryRepository categoryRepository
 -StorageService storageService
 -ProductImageValidation imageValidation
 }
 class ProductRepository {
 <<interface>>
 +findByProductId(String) Optional~Product~
 }
 class Product {
 +Long id
 +String productId
 +String name
 +BigDecimal price
 +BigDecimal taxRate
 +String description
 +String imageKey
 +Category category
 +Inventory inventory
 }
 class ProductImageValidation {
 +validate(MultipartFile)
 }

 ProductController --> ProductService
 ProductService <|.. ProductServiceImpl
 ProductServiceImpl --> ProductRepository
 ProductServiceImpl --> ProductImageValidation
 ProductRepository --> Product
 Product \"1\" --> \"1\" Category : belongs to
 Product \"1\" --> \"0..1\" Inventory : tracked by",
 "config": null
